x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
import math

if n >= y:
    g = math.gcd(x, y)
    num = x // g
    den = y // g
else:
    best_diff = 1e15
    num = 0
    den = 1
    ratio = x / y
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        candidate_floor = math.floor((x * i) / y)
        diff_floor = abs(candidate_floor / i - ratio)
        if diff_floor < best_diff:
            num = candidate_floor
            den = i
            best_diff = diff_floor
        candidate_ceil = math.ceil((x * i) / y)
        diff_ceil = abs(candidate_ceil / i - ratio)
        if diff_ceil < best_diff:
            num = candidate_ceil
            den = i
            best_diff = diff_ceil

print(f"{num}/{den}")
